scope: Read-only source contract for Ref Tip of the Day window and loader

evidence.finding: CTipOfTheDay::Load sets the tried flag before attempting I/O. For non-Korea it first resolves LanguageFile("tipofday.txt") and uses it if it exists; otherwise America fallback is tipOfTheday_e.txt, Japan tipOfTheday_j.txt, all other services tipOfTheday.txt. Korea goes directly to tipOfTheday.txt. Language-file path uses CFile; fallback paths use fopen in text read mode. Missing/open-failed file returns 0; successful file read returns 1, including an empty file.

Text format: each LF ends a display line; '#' ends the current tip, after pushing the current line, and stores the collected lines as one tip. A tip can therefore comprise multiple LF-separated strings. CR is not stripped by the shown parser. The parser only processes delimiter characters in the file-size loop; a final unterminated fragment is not added. Empty/absent data yields zero tips. GetTip lazily calls Load and invalid indices return the first tip; empty-list GetTip has no safe fallback, so callers guard on nonzero tip count.

Factory-created window is 280x180 (Ref/UIWindowMgr.cpp:5705-5722). Three bitmap buttons have IDs back=180, next=152, close=135; x positions 144,189,234, y=height-24 (=156); bitmap-derived button dimensions. Text viewer is at x=10,y=22,w=windowWidth-20 (=260),h=windowHeight-40 (=140). Show-at-startup checkbox is x=10,y=height-16 (=164), size textWidth+12 by 12, localized MSI_SHOWTIPSATSTARTUP label. It is initialized from g_showTipsAtStartup. Checkbox control message ID 147 is handled in SendMsg (0x93); checkbox toggles copy to window and global preference and writes a DWORD registry value named by aShowtipsatstar. Buttons 135 closes, 152 advances modulo count, 180 goes backward modulo count; changes redraw viewer with MSI_DIDYOUKNOW heading and tip lines (Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:13901-13959,13966-13984).

OnCreate selects rand() % tipCount only when at least one tip exists. Startup path opens the window only once, only if g_showTipsAtStartup is truthy and the loaded tip count is nonzero. Empty/missing tip file prevents startup display. User can still open via factory/action paths when not startup.

Preference is DWORD registry value queried into g_showTipsAtStartup, then Ref WinMain decompilation immediately assigns 0, and normalizes values >=2 to 1. This makes the exact original startup default/restore ordering ambiguous in Ref decompilation. The source-level dhxj reconstruction declares BOOL g_showTipsAtStartup=1. Runtime should preserve the persisted preference contract and treat absent/default as a source-evidence ambiguity rather than infer solely from one decompiled assignment.

Window manager factory case 38 creates/reuses UITipOfTheDayWnd, calls Create(280,180), positions at ((rendererWidth-640)/2+200, 120*rendererHeight/480), adds to children, and shows. Startup creates it after one-time guard once preference and tip-count conditions pass.

selection.zero_tips: startup and navigation guard; GetTip fallback would dereference empty first entry

preference.startup_default: ambiguous in Ref: decompiled WinMain queries registry then assigns 0; dhxj source reconstruction initializes global to 1
